# Required Relations

- Each source has exactly one source note.
- `wiki/topics/transport.md` owns all four expected sourced claim blocks.
- Each source note summarizes only its own source, includes no evidence from other
  sources, and links its important assertions to the relevant Transport claim.
- Mutual contradiction links connect `transport-all-new-grpc` and
  `transport-public-http`.
- Both supersession directions connect `transport-all-new-grpc` with the approved
  v2 public and internal policy claims.
- The index links every generated source note and the existing Transport topic.
- Re-ingesting `architecture-v2.md` does not add a second source note or duplicate
  claim.
- A query about the maximum upload size reports insufficient evidence; the corpus
  intentionally defines no size.
